text: In 1992, thousands of Brits bought vacuum cleaners they didn't need... just to fly to America for free.
Hoover's offer: spend 100 pounds, get two free return flights to Europe. Then it added New York and Orlando.
The cheapest vacuum that qualified cost 119 pounds. The tickets were worth a LOT more.
People did the math. By March 1993, about 200,000 had claimed flights.
Travel agents couldn't keep up. One angry customer went all the way to Iowa to confront the owner, Maytag.
Maytag paid for charter planes, fired three Hoover bosses... and took about 60 million dollars in charges in 1993.
Two years later, it sold Hoover Europe.
Hoover thought it was giving away flights to sell vacuums.
But people were buying vacuums... to get the flights.
